# AAC Speech & Communication

> AAC Speech & Communication is an offline-first, subscription-free Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) app designed for nonverbal individuals, autistic children, adults with speech challenges, parents, teachers, and speech-language therapists (SLTs).

## Core Key Features
- **Offline & Private**: Runs completely offline without needing active Wi-Fi or cellular data.
- **No Subscriptions**: Free core features with an optional one-time lifetime premium unlock.
- **Smart Board Creator**: Camera scanning tool that automatically crops and digitizes physical paper communication boards into talking digital grids.
- **Symbol & Custom Media**: Access thousands of open-source Mulberry vector symbols, custom photos, and recorded voice clips.
- **Printable Board PDF Exports**: Export custom grid layouts to high-resolution PDFs for low-tech paper backups.
- **Cross-Platform Availability**: Compatible across iOS, iPadOS, Android, and Amazon Fire OS.

## App Store & Download Links

## Educational Resources & Guides
- [AAC in the Classroom Guide](https://aacspeech.app/resources/aac-in-the-classroom-teachers-ta-guide.html): Practical strategies for teachers, TAs, and school speech therapists.
- [Proloquo2Go Alternatives](https://aacspeech.app/resources/affordable-proloquo2go-alternative-ipad-ios-android.html): Financial and accessibility guide for budget-friendly AAC options.
- [How to Make an AAC Board](https://aacspeech.app/resources/how-to-make-a-communication-board.html): Step-by-step beginner guide for parents introducing AAC at home.
- [Gestalt Language Processing & AAC](https://aacspeech.app/resources/gestalt-language-processing-aac.html): Supporting echolalia and GLP learners with visual grids.
- [Free Printable AAC Boards](https://aacspeech.app/resources/printable-boards.html): Free PDF communication board templates for classroom routines and low-tech backups.
